notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content:
Just in time for the Summer Sale, I'm thrilled to announce some bug fixes and updates to Pinstripe!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25177346/d98560c42f3ff1b4d84654e784d2ee42ffeadda5.jpg

1. Speed Demon Achievement should (fingers crossed!) be fixed!
2. Super secret fan art has been framed and hung on three different walls throughout the game! Keep your eyes peeled! 
3. New commentary tracks added! Tried to be as honest as possible in these!
4. New menu design! Happy Summer everyone! 
5. New cover art illustrated by fan Peet Cooper!

Version 2.1.0

Have fun! 
Thomas

notes.title: V 2.0.2 Update! Fixed Achievement Bug!
notes.content: Woo! Finally figured out one of the bugs regarding the Speed Demon Bug! You should be awarded the Speed Demon Bug now if you beat the game in under an hour!

notes.title: V 1.0.5 Update!
notes.content:
V 1.0.5

1. For those of you who may have had some issues getting achievements, you should now receive them on game load if you did all the requirements! 

2. Achievements will also be awarded at the end of the game if for some reason you did not get some. 

3. Other minor bugs fixed! 

4. Credits have been updated for Kickstarter backers.

Please contact Armor Games Studios with any questions/concerns: https://armorgamesstudios.com/contact/
